data.title: Projektingenieur Retrofit & Funktionale Sicherheit (gn)
data.description:
Wir suchen einen Experten (gn) für unser Team der E-Konstruktion, der/die sich hauptsächlich mit den Bereichen Retrofit und Funktionale Sicherheit auseinandersetzt.

Mittelfristig ist zudem Entwicklungspotential in dieser Funktion gegeben.

Du solltest eine langfristig orientierte Persönlichkeit sein und dich fachlich und persönlich mit den folgend genannten Aufgaben und unserem Unternehmen identifizieren können.

Aufgaben

  • Neuentwicklung von Anlagen und Komponenten

  • Retrofit - Konzeptionierung und Begleitung von Maschinenmodernisierungen

  • Weiterentwicklung im Rahmen des Produktentstehungsprozesses

  • Erstellung und Mitarbeit von Risikoanalysen für die Anlagen und Komponenten im Sinne von Maschinenrichtlinien (funktionale Sicherheit)

  • Definition und Bewertung der funktionalen Sicherheit

  • Erstellung, Freigabe und Zuordnung von Arbeitspaketen für die EK aus dem Verkaufsabschluss einer Anlage

  • Schnittstellenmanagement und Abstimmung mit anderen Abteilungen

  • Durchführung von technischen Machbarkeitsanalysen

  • Koordination des Daily-Scrum

  • Projektarbeit

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung und/oder Studium - gern mit Zusatzqualifikationen im Bereich Techniker oder ähnliches

  • Erfahrung als Elektrokonstrukteur

  • Erfahrungen im Bereich funktionaler Sicherheit

  • Fachliches Wissen hinsichtlich komplexer Konstruktionsprozesse

  • Logisches und analytisches Denkvermögen rund um die Wertschöpfungsprozesse eines Produktionsunternehmens

  • Die Lust sich in ein bestehendes gutes und positives Team zu integrieren

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub

  • Mobiles Arbeiten (Hybrid) und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Betriebliche Zusatzversicherung „Remmert Gesundheitskonto 600“ für jeden Mitarbeiter (gn): Jährliches persönliches Gesundheitsbudget in Höhe von 600 EUR Nettowert für z. Sehschärfenkorrekturen), medizinische Massagen und Maßnahmen, Zahnersatz und Zahnprophylaxe, Naturheilverfahren u. v. m.

  • Kaffee, Obst und Gemüse zum freien Verzehr – auch während der Arbeitszeiten

  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerausflug, Wandertage sowie Weihnachtsfeiern für alle Kollegen und deren Familien)

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge durch ein Zuschussmodell mit attraktiven Arbeitgeberbeiträgen

data.title: Prediction Model Expert
data.description:
About the Role



As a Prediction Model Expert, you bring deep expertise in AI forecasting, software development in Python, backed by a dissertation on prediction models or time series forecasting. You have hands-on experience with foundation models for forecasting, multi-modal prediction frameworks (can be across disciplines like medicine), cloud environments. You excel at building production-grade prediction engines that detect anomalies, forecast threats, and power proactive threat detection logic at compute scale.

You will be one of Haste's first senior AI researchers pioneering prediction models that anticipate stealthy threats across HPC clusters, AI and quantum workloads before they strike.

Key Responsibilities

  • Predictive Model Development & Engineering: Designing, building, and deploying Machine Learning (ML) and Foundation models to forecast potential security breaches.
  • Anomaly Detection & Behavior Analysis: Establishing "normal" baselines and flagging deviations that indicate malicious behaviour together with our security experts and research teams.
  • Threat Intelligence & Forecasting: Analyzing historical data, threat intelligence feeds, to extract and predict future attack trends, emerging vulnerabilities, and malicious campaigns.
  • Vulnerability & Risk Assessment: Scoring and prioritizing security vulnerabilities (e.g., predicting which CVSS vulnerabilities are most likely to be exploited) to guide risk-based view.
  • Data Pipeline Construction: Managing the full lifecycle of data, including gathering, cleaning, and processing vast amounts of diverse data sources like network logs, indicators of compromise, and threat intel.
  • Model Optimization & Maintenance: Continuously refining algorithms, hyperparameter tuning, and adapting models to combat "model drift" as attacker tactics evolve.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Translating complex mathematical models into actionable insights, and producing research reports, white papers, or conference presentations.

Why Join Haste?



If you’ve ever wanted to build the world’s fastest threat detection and hunting platform for the future of compute, this is the place for you. If you want to build technology that pushes the boundaries of cybersecurity for HPC, AI, and quantum environments, this is where you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career.

From detecting AI model poisoning mid-training to hunting quantum side-channel leaks and nation-state IP theft in HPC clusters. Haste mirrors the complexity of high-stakes compute infrastructure—HPC supercomputers, trillion-parameter AI workloads, quantum computers, and enterprise infrastructure—letting security teams detect, hunt, and analyze only relevant threats lightning fast.

We are a EU funded, fast-growing cybersecurity startup securing compute for governments, research labs, and Fortune 500 enterprises. Our mission is to secure every compute-intensive workload from AI training to quantum simulations—revolutionizing cyber defense.

What It's Like Working With Us

  • Impact from day one: Your work shapes how we protect current and future infrastructure.
  • Top Tier-experts: Join security veterans solving globally unique problems in threat detection for the future of compute.
  • Fully remote, real ownership: We care about results, not clock-in times.


Location: Remote (within Europe)

data.title: Ausbildung Sport- und Fitneskaufmann/-frau (m/w/d)
data.description:
WER SIND WIR?

Mehr als nur Fitnessstudio

Du liebst Sport, bist gern unter Menschen und hast ein Händchen fürs Organisieren? Dann lernst du bei uns, wie ein erfolgreiches Fitnessunternehmen wirklich funktioniert: vom Training bis zur Studioleitung.

Klasse statt Masse. Als Premiumanbieter für Personal Training stellen wir den einzelnen Menschen in den Mittelpunkt. Mit individuellem 1:1-Training, fundiertem Fachwissen und innovativen Methoden helfen wir unseren Kund*innen, fitter, gesünder und möglichst schmerzfrei zu leben.

Du willst Teil eines Teams sein, das wirklich etwas bewegt? Dann starte bei uns durch!

Dein Alltag bei uns

01 Das Studio mitmanagen

Du unterstützt unsere Studioleitung im Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst organisatorische sowie kaufmännische Aufgaben.

02 Kund*innen begeistern

Du koordinierst Termine, bist im Austausch mit unseren Kund*innen und behältst Abläufe und CRM-System im Griff.

03 Ideen einbringen

Marketing & Projekte: Du bringst deine Ideen ein und hilfst dabei, unser Studio weiterzuentwickeln.

04 Von Profis lernen

Im Personal Training lernst du von erfahrenen Trainer*innen und übernimmst mit wachsendem Fachwissen Schritt für Schritt eigene Aufgaben.

GUT ZU WISSEN Du startest in der Organisation, in der Administration und als Assistenz unserer Studioleitung. Mit deiner Entwicklung wächst auch deine Verantwortung im Trainingsbereich.

Deine Ausbildung bei uns

Praxis, Know-how und Zertifikate

Gemeinsam mit der Internationalen Fitnessakademie (IFAA) verbindest du drei Jahre Praxis bei SanoGym mit kaufmännischem Wissen und professionellen Trainerqualifikationen. Du erwirbst:

  • IFAA-ABSCHLUSS - Fitnessfachmann/-frau

  • IFAA-ABSCHLUSS - Fitness- und Gesundheitstrainer

  • ZUSÄTZLICH - Verschiedene Trainerlizenzen

  • Außerdem wirst du auf die IHK-Prüfung zum/zur Sport- und Fitnesskaufmann/-frau vorbereitet. Über die Zulassung entscheidet die zuständige IHK.

Deine Benefits bei uns

Wir investieren in DICH

Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung - Dein Engagement ist uns etwas wert.

100 % IFAA-Kosten übernommen - Wir investieren in deine Zukunft und zahlen deine IFAA-Ausbildung komplett.

Bezahlte Freistellung - Für alle IFAA-Ausbildungstage. Lernen gehört zu deiner Ausbildungszeit.

Geregelte Arbeitszeiten - Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche an fünf Arbeitstagen.

Wissen on top - Freiwillige Personal-Trainer-Fortbildungen am Wochenende, teilweise sogar kostenlos.

Persönliche Betreuung - Wir begleiten dich und fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Ein starkes Team - Echtes Miteinander, gegenseitige Unterstützung und jede Menge Know-how.

Perspektive bei uns - Bei sehr guten Leistungen und passendem Personalbedarf ist eine Übernahme nach der Ausbildung möglich.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

  • Begeisterung für Sport, Fitness und Gesundheit

  • Freude an Organisation, Büroarbeit und dem Umgang mit Menschen

  • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und echte Lernbereitschaft

  • Schulabschluss, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Mindestalter 18 Jahre

  • Führerschein Klasse B (von Vorteil)

Du musst noch kein Profi sein. Wichtig ist, dass du einer werden willst!

Bereit loszulegen? Zeig uns, wer du bist!

Bewirb dich direkt über den Button auf dieser Seite und beantworte drei kurze Fragen:

01 Warum SanoGym?

Was begeistert dich an uns und unserer Arbeit?

02 Sport trifft Organisation

Was reizt dich an dieser Kombination?

03 Zeig uns deinen Drive

Wann hast du selbst etwas angepackt oder Verantwortung übernommen?

Ob als kurzer Text oder kreatives Video (max. 90 Sekunden), du entscheidest!

data.title: Projektassistenz / Projektkoordination im Medizincontrolling (m/w/d)
data.description:
Das erwartet Sie

Das Privatinstitut für Klinikmanagement (PKM) ist ein führendes Weiterbildungs- und Beratungsinstitut im Gesundheitswesen. Was als bundesweit anerkannter Anbieter für die Qualifizierung von Fachkräften begann, ist heute ein ganzheitlicher Partner für Bildung und Beratung. Im Bereich operatives Medizincontrolling übernehmen wir als Dienstleister für Kliniken zentrale Aufgaben wie Primärkodierung, Kodierrevision und Datenanalysen. Dabei arbeiten wir mit einem festen Team und einem großen Netzwerk erfahrener Freelancer:innen zusammen.

Zur Unterstützung der Bereichsleitung im operativen Medizincontrolling suchen wir ab sofort eine Projektassistenz in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung bei der Koordination und Einsatzplanung unserer Freelancer:innen

  • Mitbetreuung unserer Klinikprojekte in administrativen und organisatorischen Belangen

  • Mitarbeit im Vertragsmanagement, z. B. bei der Erstellung, Verwaltung und Nachverfolgung von Verträgen mit Kliniken und Freelancer:innen

  • Unterstützung bei der Einrichtung und Verwaltung von IT-Zugängen und Berechtigungen für Kliniken und Freelancer:innen

  • Mitwirkung an einem reibungslosen Projektablauf als Ansprechpartner:in bei organisatorischen und technischen Fragen

  • Unterstützung der Geschäfts- und Bereichsleitung im operativen Projektmanagement

  • Weitere Aufgaben entsprechend Ihrer persönlichen Fähigkeiten

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung im Klinikumfeld, z. B. als MFA, Pflegefachkraft, im Patientenmanagement oder in der Verwaltung, ist wünschenswert

  • Ausgeprägte IT-Affinität und sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Plattformen und Benutzerverwaltungen (zwingend erforderlich)

  • Lösungsorientierte, selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Organisationstalent, auch wenn viele Personen und Projekte gleichzeitig zu betreuen sind

  • Kenntnisse in Kodierung oder medizinischer Abrechnung sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Eigeninitiative

Benefits

  • Ein hoch motiviertes Team mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Moderne Arbeitsplätze im Herzen von Köln

data.title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
data.description:
StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care.

Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

  • Propose a data collection strategy — research suitable public and clinical data sources, recommend patient consent and other administrative requirements for ML training (e.g., data protection agreements, ethics approval), and define collection and annotation protocols with clinical experts, including labeling guidelines and quality checks

  • Identify and validate factors that affect model performance — image conditions, dataset bias, patient diversity, data privacy and regulatory requirements

  • Define test strategies and metrics, and validate model outputs against clinician assessments

  • Perform build vs. buy analyses for models, tools and services, including cost comparison

  • Estimate compute and training costs and propose budgets for model training and deployment

  • Choose and set up training environments flexibly — local hardware or cloud — based on cost, data privacy and performance

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for the current prototyping stage and document results clearly

  • Maintain clear, traceable documentation of data sources, models, experiments and design decisions to support audits and quality reviews

  • Evaluate and integrate additional sensors where feasible (e.g., depth, LiDAR, thermal, multispectral) and fuse them with RGB input

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field — or equivalent practical background

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on use of PyTorch, OpenCV or TensorFlow

  • Solid understanding of computer vision — classification, object detection and image segmentation, 3D Reconstruction and Multi-View Geometry

  • Hands-on knowledge of transfer learning — adapting pre-trained models and fine-tuning them on custom datasets

  • Working knowledge of the full ML lifecycle — data preparation, training, evaluation and deployment

  • Basic knowledge of generative models (diffusion models or GANs) and common open-source libraries

  • Comfortable training models both locally (GPU workstation) and on cloud platforms

  • Able to estimate ML compute costs and compare build vs. buy options to support budget decisions

  • Awareness of medical imaging challenges — limited data, label variability between clinicians and class imbalance

  • Awareness of healthcare data privacy and ethics (e.g., GDPR, patient consent, anonymization) and why explainability and bias matter in clinical AI

  • Able to read research papers and apply them pragmatically

  • Self-directed and pragmatic — able to take initiative and own problems end-to-end in a lean team

  • Fluent in English — German is a bonus

Strong Plus

  • Projects or coursework in medical imaging or clinical AI

  • Familiarity with semi-supervised learning — leveraging limited or partially labeled data

  • Experience with 3D data processing — depth maps, point clouds or mesh reconstruction

  • Exposure to multi-modal learning — combining RGB and depth or LiDAR data

  • Edge AI or wearable deployment (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, model quantization)

  • Knowledge of explainability methods (e.g., Grad-CAM, SHAP) or adversarial robustness

  • Familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC, Docker)

  • Awareness of medical device regulation for AI software (e.g., EU MDR, IEC 62304)

  • Familiarity with small language models (SLMs) and speech pipelines (e.g., Whisper, on-device speech recognition and text-to-speech)

Benefits

  • Meaningful work — You help shape how technology redefines education and training in healthcare, with real impact on clinical outcomes

  • Ownership and creative freedom — You work autonomously, contribute your ideas directly, and have a genuine say in how the system is built

  • A learning culture — We support personal and professional growth through knowledge sharing, access to innovative tools and methods, and a dedicated learning budget

  • Flexible working — Remote-friendly setup with the option to work from our Munich office

  • Flat hierarchies and team spirit — A small, open, and trust-based team where communication is direct and everyone's voice matters

  • International collaboration — Work alongside a Taiwan-based partner covering technology, hardware and research

We are only able to respond to candidates selected for further consideration. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of applying, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time.

data.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on our AI Platform team, you take AI at bunch from working to relied upon. We already run AI in production — a document extraction pipeline live in fund operations, agent workflows on Mastra, evaluations, and multi-provider fallback inside EU data residency. Fund operations run on documents, deadlines and numbers that have to be right — subscription documents to parse, capital calls to chase, portfolio data to reconcile. You build on that foundation: more agents taking that work off people's hands, the evaluations that prove they can be trusted with it, and the platform that lets every other team at bunch ship the same way. This is end-to-end product engineering, not research: you own architecture, evaluation, integration, and deployment.

Top Priorities

  • Build and ship agents. Design agents that automate real fund-operations workflows, and own them from prototype through production and after. They integrate with our services, data model, and authorization system — they don't sit beside the product as standalone prototypes.

  • Evaluate and improve agent performance. Build the evaluation layer: test cases built from real documents with the output we expect, regression suites in CI, human review where correctness is non-negotiable, and clear success criteria for an agent completing a complex task end to end. Then move the numbers that matter — accuracy, latency, cost.

  • Own the AI application architecture. Orchestration and multi-agent design, tool contracts, memory, and context engineering (RAG, MCP) with clear domain boundaries — plus the guardrails, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls that anything touching investor money requires.

  • Run it in production. Versioned, feature-flagged rollout of agent versions; rate limits, provider fallback, and regional failover within EU data residency; and the observability to trace a failure across services and turn it into a fix rather than a theory.

  • Make it a platform, not a project. Document parsing and extraction consolidates into this team, and shared evaluation and observability become something other teams consume rather than rebuild. You set the patterns other engineers inherit, partner closely with DevX, and mentor engineers across teams on agent and LLM practice.

Your First 90 Days

  • Review our MCP offering end to end and ship it to the first customers, with the access boundaries, evaluation and observability a customer-facing surface needs.

  • Stand up shared observability for our AI workloads — token usage, estimated cost, latency, failures and retries per provider — on a dashboard people actually open during an incident.

  • Publish v1 of our agent patterns (domain boundaries, tool contracts, prompt and eval conventions), reviewed with DevX and adopted by at least one team outside AI Platform.

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years building production software, including at least one agent or LLM-powered capability you took end to end and still owned once it was live

  • Agents: real depth in orchestration and context engineering — tool contracts, memory, RAG, multi-agent design — with Mastra, ai-sdk, LangGraph or similar. You've integrated agents into a real product and its authorization model, not built prototypes for someone else to productionise

  • Evaluation: you know how to make a non-deterministic system measurable, from test cases built on real data to regression suites and human review, and you can tell the difference between a model that improved and a benchmark that got easier

  • Production: you own what you ship. Reading traces, diagnosing failure modes, tuning cost and latency, handling provider rate limits and fallback without drama

  • Backend: You have experience with TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Platform mindset: you build for other engineers as much as for end users, and the standards you set get adopted because people trust you, not because they are written down

  • Pragmatic: you start from the business outcome, choose the deterministic solution when it's the right one, and know when good enough is good enough

  • Experience in fintech, private markets, or another regulated, document-heavy domain is a plus, as is working under EU data-residency constraints

Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, Svelte and React

  • Backend: Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL

  • AI: Mastra, Vercel ai-sdk, Google Vertex (Gemini) with AWS Bedrock fallback in EU regions

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Auth & Internal tools: FusionAuth, Retool

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us and check initial fit.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 min) – Explore product-focused culture, collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

  3. Technical Interviews (2 x 60 min) – Two technical conversations, one with our engineers to discuss topics like system and agent-design questions, and one focused on core AI technical topics

  4. Final Round with our CTO Leandro (45 min) – Discuss ways of working, bunch’s engineering vision, and team culture.

Questions? Reach out to ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

data.title: E-Commerce Manager (m/w/d) – Marktplätze & Internationalisierung
data.description:
Deine Rolle bei AYLASHES

Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen, organisierst Projekte und bleibst dran, bis ein Launch steht? Bei AYLASHES entwickeln wir DIY-Wimpernextensions für zu Hause. Jetzt möchten wir unsere Produkte in weiteren Ländern und auf neuen Marktplätzen anbieten – und suchen dich, um diesen Ausbau mit uns voranzubringen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Marktplätzen und Internationalisierung. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketingteam, Agenturen und Logistikpartnern zusammen. Welche Länder und Plattformen wir zuerst angehen, entscheiden wir gemeinsam. Du übersetzt die Prioritäten in konkrete Schritte und hältst die Umsetzung auf Kurs.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neue Länder erschließen: Du koordinierst die Vorbereitung und den Start unseres Shopify-Shops, von Amazon und TikTok Shop in weiteren Ländern – mit klaren Aufgaben, Zuständigkeiten und Terminen.

  • Marktplätze aufbauen und betreuen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern entwickelst du unsere Präsenz auf Plattformen wie Amazon, TikTok Shop, Douglas, ABOUT YOU, Zalando und OTTO weiter. Du prüfst Produktdaten, Listings, Preise und Verfügbarkeit und sorgst dafür, dass offene Punkte erledigt werden.

  • Zahlen verstehen und verbessern: Du behältst Umsatz, Profitabilität, Conversion, Werbeeffizienz und Bestände im Blick. Auffälligkeiten gehst du nach und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team und den Agenturen konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Agenturen steuern: Du erstellst Briefings, koordinierst lokale Marketingmaßnahmen, prüfst Ergebnisse und hältst vereinbarte Termine nach.

  • Den gesamten Launch zusammenbringen: Du stimmst Übersetzungen, lokale Werbematerialien, Versand und Retouren mit den zuständigen Partnern ab. Länder- und Plattformanforderungen klärst du mit den jeweiligen Fachleuten und sorgst mit unserem Lagerteam für funktionierende Abläufe.

  • Shopify weiterentwickeln: Ergänzend bringst du Themen wie unseren AYLASHES Club, Referral-Programme, Kundenvorteile und Club-Seiten gemeinsam mit den passenden Partnern voran.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits praktische E-Commerce-Erfahrung gesammelt, zum Beispiel bei einer Marke, einem Onlineshop oder einer Agentur, und selbst operative Aufgaben oder Projekte verantwortet.

  • Du hast schon mit Shopify gearbeitet und erste praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem Marktplatz. Du musst noch nicht jede Plattform kennen.

  • Du gehst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets um und kannst aus Zahlen konkrete nächste Schritte ableiten. Du verstehst, wie Marketingmaßnahmen, Conversion und wirtschaftliche Ergebnisse zusammenhängen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, setzt Prioritäten und fragst aktiv nach, wenn etwas stockt. Auch Datenpflege und regelmäßige Kontrollen gehören für dich dazu.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch, kannst dich auf Englisch gut mit Partnern abstimmen und hast deinen Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

Erfahrung mit Länderlaunches oder Agentursteuerung ist ein Plus. Entscheidend sind für uns deine bisherige Praxis, dein Zahlenverständnis und die Motivation, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Eine Festanstellung in Vollzeit – 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam und unserer Gründerin Aylin sowie kurze Abstimmungswege.

  • Ein klarer Schwerpunkt auf dem Ausbau unserer Vertriebskanäle und die Möglichkeit, sichtbare Ergebnisse mitzugestalten.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen und Fachpartnern sowie Raum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Lust, mit uns zu wachsen?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Starttermin. Im Bewerbungsformular interessiert uns außerdem ein konkretes Beispiel aus deiner bisherigen E-Commerce-Arbeit. Ein langes Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Als Paid Social & Analytics Manager (m/w/d) bei everdrop werden das deine Hauptaufgaben sein:

  • Betreuung unserer META-Accounts: Eigenverantwortliches Setup, Strukturierung, Targeting und Optimierung unserer META-Accounts.

  • Planung & Umsetzung von Growth-Kampagnen: Implementierung und Monitoring von wachstumsstarken Kampagnen zur Neukundengewinnung vorrangig in der DACH-Region, aber auch Frankreich, Italien und weiteren Märkten.

  • Reporting & Optimierung: Marktübergreifende Koordination der Performance, Erstellung fundierter Reports und Ableitung datenbasierter Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management.


DAS BIST DU

Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Wir glauben, das könnte ein gutes Match sein!

Bei everdrop arbeiten Menschen mit Growth Mindset, die Lust darauf haben, immer wieder Neues zu lernen. Wenn du gerne eigene Ideen einbringst, Lust hast, Dinge von Beginn an mitzugestalten und die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen mitbringst, könnte das der Anfang einer wunderbaren Love Story sein.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im META-Performance-Marketing im D2C-Umfeld oder in einem dynamischen Agenturumfeld auf hohem Skalierungsniveau.

  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du bist absolut sicher im Umgang mit Daten sowie Tools wie Excel/Sheets (Pivot-Tabellen) und hast bereits Erfahrungen mit Tableau oder GA4 gesammelt.

  • Plattform-Expertise: Du bist stets am Puls der Zeit, was META-Best-Practices, Algorithmus-Updates und neue Ad-Formate angeht.

  • Performance-Mindset: Du verstehst die zentralen Wachstumsmetriken und weißt genau, wie du CAC, Conversion Rates und Umsatz optimal in Einklang bringst.

  • Kommunikation: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau). Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.


DAS IST EVERDROP

Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎


Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub (plus am 24.12. und 31.12. frei)

  • JobRad-Leasing für dein neues Traumradl

  • Kostenloses veganes Mittagessen einmal pro Woche und Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine

  • ein monatlicher Gutschein für everdrop Produkte in unserem Mitarbeitershop

  • Familien- und Freunde-Rabattcodes für everdrop und andere Startups for Tomorrow-Unternehmen

  • Mitgliedschaft und Discounts über FutureBens & Corporate Benefits


Darüber hinaus erwarten dich ein wunderschönes, offenes Büro in der Nähe der Isar, ein Macbook solange du bei everdrop arbeitest, regelmäßige Team-Events, ein starker Teamgeist und ganz viele Office-Hunde die sich schon darauf freuen, dich kennenzulernen!

Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Unser Commitment, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen, ist mit JEDI-Prinzipien verbunden. JEDI steht für Gerechtigkeit, Chancengerechtigkeit, Vielfalt und Inklusion (= Justice, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion). Wir verstehen diese Prinzipien als Grundlage unseres alltäglichen Handelns – sowohl intern beim Recruiting und innerhalb unserer Arbeitsabläufe, als auch gegenüber unseren Kund*innen und der Gesellschaft.   • In der Community: Wir nutzen unsere Plattform, um das Bewusstsein für soziale und ökologische Gerechtigkeit zu stärken.

Im Arbeitsalltag orientieren wir uns an unseren vier “Core Values”. Sie geben ganz klar vor, wie wir als Individuen und im Team miteinander arbeiten wollen:

#2 WE TAKE OWNERSHIP

#3 WE ARE SOLUTION-ORIENTED

#4 WE ARE AWARE

Wir behandeln jeden Menschen gleich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Aussehen, Sprache, Kultur, Nationalität, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung oder körperlicher Einschränkung.

data.title: Bilanzbuchhalter / Referent Rechnungswesen (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
data.description:
Wir stellen uns vor!

Die Dr. Bernhard Burger AG ist ein wachsendes Familienunternehmen in zweiter Generation und einer der führenden Partner für Goldschmiede, Juweliere und Edelmetallhändler. Gemeinsam mit unserem Joint Venture Burger & Gyr Edelmetalle Recycling AG am selben Standort in Keltern, zwischen Pforzheim und Karlsruhe, verbinden wir Edelmetallrecycling, Analyse, Abrechnung, Metallkonten, Handel und eigene Fertigung.

Unser Rechnungswesen bildet die Werteflüsse beider Gesellschaften ab: von der Scheidgutabrechnung über Metallkonten bis zu Monats- und Jahresabschluss. In den nächsten zwei Jahren führen wir ein neues, voll integriertes ERP-System auf Odoo-Basis ein. Damit wachsen die Themen, die wir kaufmännisch sauber durchdenken, abstimmen und zu Ende bringen müssen.

Deshalb suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Persönlichkeit mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Überblick, die der kaufmännischen Leitung in Abschlüssen, Steuern, Finanzierung und Projekten spürbar Arbeit abnimmt, in der Buchhaltung selbst mit anpackt und tatkräftig im ERP-Projekt mitarbeitet. Einen Jahresabschluss müssen Sie nicht allein erstellen, aber wesentliche Abschlussarbeiten sicher übernehmen und mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern intensiv zusammenarbeiten.

Wir messen Erfolg daran, dass Abschlüsse und Meldungen für beide Gesellschaften termingerecht und nachvollziehbar vorliegen, dass die kaufmännische Leitung bei Koordination und Zuarbeit entlastet wird und dass unsere Prozesse nach der ERP-Einführung einfacher und sicherer laufen als heute.

Die Stelle in Kürze

Sie übernehmen wesentliche Abschlussarbeiten für zwei Gesellschaften, entlasten unsere kaufmännische Leitung bei Steuern, Finanzierung und Analysen und begleiten als Key User die Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems auf Odoo-Basis.

Welche Aufgabenfelder erwarten Sie?

Ihr Schwerpunkt ist die Bilanzbuchhaltung. Im ERP-Projekt sind Sie Key User Rechnungswesen/Finanzen: Sie begleiten den Fortschritt, testen, ob alles wie vorgesehen funktioniert, denken und handeln mit und übernehmen bei Bedarf eigene Aufgaben oder Teilprojekte. Die Projektverantwortung bleibt bei unserer kaufmännischen Leitung.

  • Mitwirkung an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB für zwei Gesellschaften: Abschlussbuchungen, Kontenabstimmungen, Rückstellungen, Anlagenbuchhaltung, Datenaustausch mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern
  • Operative Unterstützung der Finanzbuchhaltung, Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und steuerliche Fragestellungen des Tagesgeschäfts
  • Unterstützung der kaufmännischen Leitung in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Themen: Analysen, Auswertungen, Unterlagen für Vorstand und Banken, Vertrags- und Finanzierungsfragen
  • ERP-Einführung: Anforderungen der Finanzen mitformulieren, Prozesse dokumentieren, Stammdaten abgleichen, Tests durchführen, Key User Finanzen
  • Besonderheiten der Edelmetallbranche kennenlernen und mitgestalten: Metallkonten, Reverse Charge, Metallbilanz, Bestandsbewertung
  • Prozesse im Rechnungswesen weiterentwickeln und automatisieren, dabei selbst anpacken: vom Beleg bis zur Abschlussbuchung, perspektivisch eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und fachliche Koordination im Team

Was zeichnet Sie aus?

  • Betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen oder Abschluss als Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen eines mittelständischen Unternehmens oder einer Steuerkanzlei, mit Mitwirkung an Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB
  • Überblick über kaufmännische Zusammenhänge: Sie denken über die einzelne Buchung hinaus und können Themen für Entscheidungen aufbereiten
  • Pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität: Sie packen operativ mit an, finden praktikable Lösungen statt perfekter Konzepte und bringen Themen zu Ende
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise, klare Priorisierung und offene Kommunikation im Team
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit einem Systemwechsel oder einer ERP-Einführung ist ein Plus, Odoo-Kenntnisse ebenfalls, beides keine Voraussetzung
  • Sensibilität im Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen

Worauf Sie sich freuen können:

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der kaufmännischen Leitung und ein breites Themenspektrum statt Routine
  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem ERP-Projekt, das das ganze Unternehmen verändert
  • Zwei Gesellschaften, ein Team: kurze Wege zu Vorstand, Technik und Vertrieb
  • Eigene Verantwortungsbereiche im Tagesgeschäft und schrittweise Übernahme von mehr Verantwortung
  • Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), unterstützen wir fachlich und finanziell
  • Mitarbeiterevents und ein kollegiales Umfeld
  • Gleitzeit und 30 Tage Urlaub

Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

You will be in our B2B team which works on:

data.title: Founders Associate Intern
data.description:
Join Ark at an exciting stage and learn first-hand how a startup is built.

Ark builds platforms for public administrations. We entered the market about a year ago with our best-known tool, a platform for local climate action, and now work with more than 60 cities, counties and states, from Schleswig-Holstein, Munich and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised €2.4 million in pre-seed and grant funding and are approaching €1 million in annual revenue.

As our Founders Associate Intern (all genders), you work side by side with our Chief of Staff Lennart, who is your day-to-day lead, and team up with our founder & CEO Ruth on selected projects. Your week has two halves. In the mornings you are part of our growth team and help win new public administrations as customers. This is the core of the role. In the afternoons you work with Lennart on whatever matters most for the company at that moment, from strategy and finance to HR and company initiatives.

You will see from the inside how a fast-growing GovTech startup wins customers, makes decisions and builds its team. If you are thinking about founding your own company one day, there are few better places to learn.

Tasks

Joining Ark as a Founders Associate Intern means a new mix of topics every week. Here is a range of potential challenges:

  • Growth: Spend your mornings with our sales team. Research and reach out to municipalities, qualify leads, book meetings and prepare customer conversations. You learn how public sector sales work and see your impact in our pipeline every week. You'll receive a bonus for each qualified demo booked.

  • Strategy: Work with Lennart on strategic questions, prepare analyses and decision papers for management and turn decisions into concrete next steps.

  • Company Initiatives: Take full ownership of projects that move Ark forward, from preparing and hosting webinars for municipalities to legal and administrative topics a growing company has to get right.

  • People & HR: Support our recruiting from job posting to interview, help onboard new team members and contribute to initiatives that shape our team culture.

  • Finance: Help with financial planning, budgeting and reporting, for example when preparing updates for our investors.

Requirements

We are looking for people who enjoy switching between very different topics and want real responsibility from day one. Here is what makes you the right fit:

First Experience: Ideally first internships in a fast growing startup, consulting, VC or ops role. How quickly you learn matters more to us than your CV.

Drive in Sales: You enjoy talking to people, are not afraid of the phone and want to learn how to win customers. Half of your time is growth work, so this should excite you rather than be something you accept.

Structured Way of Working: You keep track of several topics at once and deliver reliably, even when priorities change during the day.

Analytical Mindset: You are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets and can turn complex information into a clear recommendation.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication to engage with municipalities, partners and our team.

Entrepreneurial Spirit: You thrive in a fast-paced startup setting and see limited resources as a chance to innovate. You are hands-on, proactive and a natural problem-solver.

Language: Excellent German and English skills.

Admin:

  • Time commitment: Internship, 6 months

  • Start date: asap

  • Location: Munich or Berlin, in office

🤗 We know that perfect candidates don’t exist and we don’t have specific “minimum qualifications”. Curiosity, eagerness to learn, a passion to tackle climate change, a collaborative spirit and a growth mindset are most important to us.

Benefits

💸 Competitive Compensation Package: We value your skills and expertise. Enjoy a salary that reflects your impact.

🚀 Ownership & Growth from Day One: Take on responsibility from the start, tackle exciting challenges and accelerate your career with a steep learning curve.

🛖 Offices in Munich and Berlin: Join us at WERK1, Munich’s up-and-coming tech hub in the Werksviertel, or in our new Berlin office.

🎉 Team Events & Culture: Join a vibrant team with fun social events and a culture of open feedback and continuous learning.

💛 Exclusive Perks & Benefits: Stay active with an EGYM Wellpass / Urban Sports Club membership, plus enjoy discounts on top sustainability brands.

Your team will be

  • Lennart (Chief of Staff), your day-to-day lead

  • Ruth (CEO & Founder)

Ready to apply?

Note: We are currently only able to hire from inside the EU, please only apply if you are based in the EU or are allowed to work here.

Ark Climate is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Data, Infrastructure & AI
data.description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.

About the role

You will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation.

This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably.

That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. The immediate priority is dependable software that customers can use, with more capable automation developed around specific tasks.

What you will build and improve

  • Application services and customer features. Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support.

  • The database foundation. Design clear data models, enforce relationships and transaction boundaries, and improve slow queries. Manage schema changes through reviewed migrations, preserve financial history and keep each customer’s data isolated.

  • Imports and integrations. Connect accounting tools, business systems and spreadsheets to a consistent model. Validate incoming records, handle changing source formats, and check that imported totals and reports agree with the source.

  • Reliable background processing. Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team.

  • Performance and recovery. Diagnose expensive queries, processing bottlenecks and partial failures. Test changes against real databases, plan for growing workloads, and build procedures to recover processing safely with the platform engineer.

  • Practical AI automation. Add features such as extracting invoice fields or preparing an order from approved business data. Give models access through controlled services, check the result and require approval where needed. Develop connected customer knowledge when a feature needs those relationships, and measure whether it improves the result.

For example, a large customer import stops halfway through and the same records arrive again on the next run. You would make processing resume safely, prevent duplicate records, verify the resulting totals and expose the job’s status in the product. You would also investigate whether database queries or worker capacity caused the failure and ship the necessary fix.

What you bring

You have seven or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production applications and data systems. You have designed relational data models, built services and processing pipelines, and stayed responsible for them after release. You are comfortable delivering across the stack and using AI tools in your daily work.

You can explain how you diagnosed a slow query, recovered a failed job or shipped a database change safely. You understand what happens when two requests arrive at once, a dependency becomes unavailable or a process restarts halfway through its work. You can follow a problem from a source record through the application to the result a customer sees.

Core experience

  • Full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, or closely comparable technologies.

  • Relational data modelling, SQL, query optimisation, indexes, transactions and reviewed database migrations.

  • Application services and APIs, including permissions, validation and handling concurrent requests.

  • Data imports, integrations and background jobs, including queues, safe retries and recovery from partial failures.

  • Production debugging, service monitoring and performance work on systems used by real customers.

  • Automated tests against real databases and other service dependencies.

  • Practical use of AI in software, with an understanding of how to check outputs and control access to customer data.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents, with direct responsibility for code review and verification.

  • A computer science or computer engineering degree, or equivalent practical depth.

Useful additional experience

Financial or operational systems where correctness and traceability matter; larger data migrations; cloud storage and container-based workloads. Experience putting document extraction or features using large language models (LLMs) into production would be valuable. Knowledge graphs, which connect related company records, and privately hosted or adapted models are useful as we develop that part of the product.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take ownership of an existing service or data flow, understand how it runs in production and ship a customer-facing improvement through it. You would address a concrete reliability or performance problem, such as a slow report, a fragile integration or a job that cannot recover cleanly after interruption.

We would look for working features, faster and more predictable processing, fewer failed or manually repaired jobs, and useful tests and monitoring. An early automation feature could follow where the data and services are ready and its benefit can be measured.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a dependable application backbone: processing completes, records reconcile and customers can trust the results. When a job fails or figures disagree, you take ownership of the investigation and recovery. Missing transactions, duplicate entries or unexplained balance differences can be financial emergencies even while every service appears available. You assess the impact, contain affected processing, trace the cause and verify the repaired result before treating the incident as resolved.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role in a small team. You will own the application and data infrastructure for your work, and carry a full share of customer feature delivery. You will collaborate across infrastructure, operations and product design to deliver complete customer outcomes. You will use coding agents to implement changes and remain responsible for reviewing, testing and operating the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole product and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and in-person in Berlin. German is not required.

A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. Both should understand where they are, what a number means and what to do next.

This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering. You will talk to customers, shape the journey, design the interactions and ship them in the product. You will use AI coding agents to help implement changes, and take responsibility for reviewing the code and checking the finished experience.

Your work will connect the product into a coherent whole: consistent navigation, familiar controls and clear explanations across features. You will also own the steps that turn an interested visitor into an active, paying customer.

What you will build and improve

  • An engaging path from first interest to a useful result. Connect landing pages and product demonstrations to sign-up, account setup and the first session so a customer understands what to provide and what they will get back. Measure where people abandon the process and address the causes.

  • A migration experience people can follow. Help customers bring in their history from accounting software or spreadsheets. Make upload progress, missing information, validation errors and next steps understandable.

  • A consistent product experience. Develop the design language, navigation and reusable components used across the product. Make tables, forms and reports behave predictably, including loading, empty and error states.

  • Useful decision screens. Design views that help customers compare recommendations, understand costs and choose what happens next. Our planned evidence board brings this information together as customers describe their needs.

  • Interfaces that earn trust. Help users see where a figure came from, understand a proposed change and review it before approval. Include accessibility, keyboard use and clear language in the implementation.

  • Improvements grounded in actual use. Keep up with the customer pipeline, from interested prospects to customers onboarding or migrating. Observe customer sessions and work with the customer-facing team. Turn recurring questions into product changes, then check whether those changes helped.

For example, a customer uploads a file and sees a different total from the one they expected. You would design the journey that explains what was imported, what needs checking and how to resolve the difference, working with the data engineer on the underlying evidence.

What you bring

You have five or more years of experience designing and shipping software, including business-to-business software sold as a service (B2B SaaS). You may come from product design with strong engineering skills, or from front-end engineering with substantial design ownership.

You can show a product journey you improved, explain the choices you made and describe the effect on customers. You have owned an onboarding, activation or conversion measure: whether people got started, reached a useful result or became paying customers.

Core experience

  • Product design across information architecture, interaction design and visual design.

  • Production front-end work with React, TypeScript, CSS and reusable components, including reviewing and debugging code generated by agents.

  • Building or maintaining a design system that other people use.

  • Customer research, usability testing and product analytics that inform what you ship.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents, with a clear approach to specifications, review and verification.

  • Clear written explanations of design decisions and their trade-offs.

Useful additional experience

Financial software, complex tables and dashboards, or products where people need to inspect the source of a result. Experience with configuration-driven interfaces, where shared rules and data determine how a screen is assembled, would also be useful.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would map the main customer journeys, establish a baseline for onboarding and conversion, and ship an improvement to a step where customers regularly get stuck. Alongside that, you would start consolidating repeated interface patterns into reusable components.

We would look for evidence that customers reach a useful result sooner, complete more of the journey independently and need less help with the interface. The exact priorities will follow the customer needs you find with the team.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a product customers can depend on under pressure. When sign-up, migration or a critical financial workflow breaks, you step in, establish what the customer needs and work with the team to restore a safe path forward. A misleading balance, missing transaction or incorrect status can be a financial emergency even when the page loads normally. You make the problem visible, help contain its impact and verify the complete customer journey after a fix.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role in a small team, with scope to shape product decisions and engineering practice. Die VLITEX GmbH mit Sitz in Bayreuth entwickelt und vertreibt innovative Brandschutzlösungen aus technischen Textilien mit Fokus auf Lithium-Ionen-Batterien. data.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary: 120-160k • Total Comp: 200k

We're looking for a highly analytical, data-driven Director of Customer Lifecycle (CRM) who will architect a sophisticated, machine-learning-adjacent customer lifecycle engine designed to maximize long-term retention and engagement across our global user base.

Your mission is to bring structure, rigorous experimentation, and algorithmic scalability to a CRM system that is complex by nature — with many entry points, diverse user flows, and a high bar for automation. You will sit at the intersection of marketing, product, and data science, moving comfortably from high-level retention strategy to hands-on pipeline and campaign execution.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own Lifecycle Architecture & First-Day Experience: Own the full CRM strategy, with a heavy emphasis on mapping day-0 (d0) user behavior to optimize early-stage retention and long-term user monetization.

  • Build Algorithmic Personalization: Move beyond static batch-and-blast and basic segmentation. You will collaborate with Data Science to deploy predictive logic, user-level personalization models, and behavioral triggers across Email, Push, SMS, and In-App.

  • Drive Rigorous Experimentation: Establish a world-class testing culture. You will design, execute, and analyze systematic experiments that look past surface-level metrics to measure true incrementality and downstream KPI impact (e.g., Day-30, Day-90 retention).

  • Partner on Data Schema: Work directly with Data and Engineering to design, audit, and optimize the CRM data schema, ensuring real-time event tracking is clean, correctly mapped, and actionable.

  • Execute & Scale: While you own the strategy, you are also the primary operator in the early stages. You will build, troubleshoot, and optimize complex logic loops and API-triggered campaigns yourself.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Data Fluency & Measurement Rigor: You speak the same language as data scientists. You have a deep understanding of statistical significance, multi-variant testing, and how to isolate incremental lift.

  • Hands-on Platform Mastery: Mastery of omnichannel orchestration platforms (e.g., Braze). You have a proven track record of personally building complex liquid logic, API-triggered webhooks, and multi-step Canvas flows without needing an intermediary team to execute for you.

data.title: Software Engineer, Operations Research
data.description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

What you'll do

CircuitHub builds circuit boards on demand, every order different. Each day thousands of decisions are made: which orders run on which machines, which parts to buy and when, what to promise a customer and what to charge. You'll build the models behind those decisions.

  • Plan the factory. Schedule orders, panels and machines across our factories for throughput and on-time delivery, and know days ahead when we will run out of work or capacity.

  • Model the Grid. The Grid is our factory-scale robot: dozens of movers, gantries, printers and ovens. Model how work flows through it, find the bottlenecks, and tell us what the next machine or change is worth.

  • Price and promise. Estimate what an order really costs in labour, machine time and parts, and help set prices and lead times that win work and make money.

  • Buy smarter. Decide what parts and consumables to stock, when to order them, and how much risk of a shortage to accept.

  • Put it into production. Your models don't live in a spreadsheet: they run every day, feed the planning and quoting systems, and get checked against what actually happened.

What we look for

  • A quantitative background in operations research, applied maths, statistics, quantitative finance, economics or a similar field, and a record of models that changed real decisions.

  • Optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint programming, or heuristics, and judgement about when a simple rule beats a solver.

  • Simulation and forecasting: building a model of a messy system, calibrating it to data and saying how far to trust it.

  • Strong Python and SQL. You write code other people can run and rely on.

  • You use coding agents to move faster and take full ownership of what they produce.

  • Curiosity about how things are physically made. You'll spend time in our factories in the US and UK.

Manufacturing experience is welcome but not required. If you have priced risk, optimised a portfolio or forecast demand, the problems here will feel familiar.

Stack

  • Modelling: Python, OR-Tools, simulation

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, Dagster

  • Agents: Claude Code and Codex throughout

Location

Remote anywhere, or from our offices in London or Cambridge (UK) if you prefer, with regular visits to our factories in the UK and US.

Pay

UK £80k–£125k · US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity.

data.title: Senior Hardware Certification Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
As a Senior Hardware Certification Engineer with focus on DO-254, you will be an important part of our Certification and Systems Engineering organization, supporting the development and certification of advanced unmanned aircraft systems.

Your main focus will be the development assurance and certification of airborne electronic hardware. You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Ensure bidirectional requirements traceability between system requirements, hardware requirements, design data and verification evidence.

  • Review hardware requirements, conceptual and detailed designs, verification activities and lifecycle data against DO-254 objectives.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware.

  • Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence.

  • Good understanding of FPGA / CPLD or complex electronic hardware development, electronic hardware and PCB development, hardware requirements and design reviews, requirements-based verification, configuration management, change control, requirements traceability, verification independence, and COTS or reused hardware assessment.

  • Experience creating or reviewing DO-254 lifecycle documents such as PHAC, HVP, HCMP and HAS is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with AC 20-152A or comparable authority guidance for airborne electronic hardware is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of related aerospace development and safety standards such as ARP4754A, ARP4761 / ARP4761A and DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Experience working with aviation certification authorities or within a DOA or military airworthiness environment is advantageous.

  • Structured and analytical working style with a strong focus on traceability, evidence and technical correctness.

  • Ability to communicate complex certification requirements effectively to hardware engineers and other engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German language skills are beneficial.

data.title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – Contract (all genders)
data.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

Normal Computing | Build with Us

Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London.

The Role

Validating conventional silicon is a solved discipline. Validating silicon that computes with noise is not, and you will be the one who figures out how. As our FPGA Design Engineer, you will own the bridge between RTL and physical silicon: bringing our physics-inspired ASIC designs to life on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon validation and early software development, and building the test infrastructure for post-silicon bring-up and characterization. Your scope spans the entire FPGA lifecycle: selecting hardware platforms, implementing complex RTL, debugging in the lab, and writing the software that drives it all, working daily with our silicon, EDA, and research teams.

What You Will Own

  • FPGA Platform Ownership: Lead the selection, procurement, and bring-up of FPGA prototyping platforms (e.g., HAPS, VCU118/VPK180-class boards, or custom hardware) for pre-silicon RTL validation and software development.

  • RTL Implementation: Adapt and implement complex ASIC RTL onto FPGA targets, including multi-clock-domain architectures, CDC bridges, and timing closure on dense designs.

  • IP Integration: Integrate in-house designs with third-party and vendor IP; serve as the expert on the AMD/Xilinx ecosystem (Vivado IP Integrator, transceivers, memory controllers).

  • High-Speed Interfaces: Design, implement, and validate high-speed I/O with a focus on PCIe: our accelerators ship as PCIe cards in standard servers.

  • Post-Silicon Validation: Build FPGA-based "tester" designs for silicon bring-up, device characterization, and automated test environments.

  • Hardware-Software Stack: Develop the software layer around the hardware: Python/C++ hardware abstraction, register-map generation, and automated build and regression flows.

  • Lab Debug: Root-cause complex timing and functional issues in real time using ILA/Vivado Analyzer, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and BER/eye-diagram characterization of high-speed links.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Proven industry experience taking FPGA designs from RTL through timing closure to validated hardware, ideally in an ASIC prototyping, emulation, or high-growth hardware environment.

  • Expert-level SystemVerilog and/or VHDL for synthesis, with deep proficiency in Xilinx Vivado (synthesis, place & route, timing closure, IP catalog).

  • Hands-on experience implementing and debugging PCIe, plus AXI/AHB, SPI, UART, JTAG, and other common interfaces.

  • Strong Python for automation, test, and build tooling.

  • Strong board-level bring-up and lab debugging skills on real hardware.

  • Startup mindset: you work independently, pivot quickly, and run at ambiguous problems that span hardware, software, and physics.

Bonus Points

  • Verification frameworks like Cocotb or UVM

  • Experience deploying ML models to FPGAs (hls4ml, FINN, or custom NN-to-RTL flows), or building real-time, sub-microsecond signal processing pipelines.

  • Mixed-signal ASIC exposure: digital front-ends, ADC/DAC interfaces, or analog compute.

  • SERDES tuning and signal integrity fundamentals.

  • CI/CD for hardware (GitLab CI, Docker-based build and test).
