data.title: Stage de Master 2 : Comprendre les transformations structurales des hydrates de sels inorganiques pour le stockage d’énergie thermochimique - 5 à 6 mois
data.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire de Master 2, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de formation, recherche et innovation, au sein du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF, UMR CNRS 5307), Centre SPIN. Dans ce laboratoire, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le LGF est une unité mixte de recherche CNRS et Mines Saint-Étienne. Il étudie la structure, les propriétés et la réactivité des matériaux, des poudres aux procédés énergétiques. Sa force : relier ce qui se passe à l’échelle du cristal à la performance d’un procédé.

Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement.

Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Ce stage suivra la transformation in situ afin d’identifier quelles phases apparaissent, dans quel ordre et avec quelle cinétique, et de comprendre pourquoi la réhydratation peut rester incomplète. Les hydrates de SrBr₂ servent de système modèle ; l’approche s’étend à d’autres hydrates de sels et à d’autres réactions gaz-solide.

• Vous réalisez une revue de la littérature sur les hydrates de sels pour le stockage thermochimique.

• Vous menez des cycles de déshydratation/réhydratation suivis par diffraction des rayons X in situ, sous température et humidité contrôlées.

• Vous quantifiez les fractions de phases par affinement de Rietveld (TOPAS, GSAS-II).

• Vous reliez structure et performance (fraction récupérée, vitesse de réaction, stabilité en cyclage).

• Vous rendez compte de vos résultats dans un mémoire et une présentation orale, avec une publication possible.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et faire dialoguer expérimentation, structure et performance sera essentielle pour réussir.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous préparez un diplôme Bac + 5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs) en science des matériaux, physique, chimie du solide ou génie des procédés.

Et idéalement :

·        Des bases en cristallographie et en diffraction des rayons X

·        Une première expérience en caractérisation des matériaux

·        Junior accepté : oui

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

·        Goût pour l’expérimental et l’analyse de données

·        Rigueur, autonomie et curiosité scientifique

·        Bon niveau d’anglais scientifique (B2 minimum)

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

data.title: Stage de Master 2 : Formulation et caractérisation de liants magnésiens à faible empreinte carbone - 5 à 6 mois
data.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

La production de béton est responsable d'environ 8 % des émissions mondiales de CO2. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel.

Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. Ces ressources constituent des sources alternatives de matières premières et pourraient permettre d'éviter les émissions de CO2 liées à la décarbonatation du calcaire.

Cependant, ces liants alternatifs sont encore en cours de développement et leurs mécanismes d'hydratation, leur composition et leurs propriétés mécaniques doivent être mieux compris. En particulier, la nature et la réactivité de la source de magnésium, ainsi que les conditions de formulation et de préparation, peuvent influencer la microstructure et les performances mécaniques du matériau obtenu.

L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier différentes sources de magnésium et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour le développement de liants de type MgO-SiO2 présentant de bonnes propriétés mécaniques et un impact environnemental réduit.

Plusieurs formulations de liants seront préparées et étudiées en faisant varier la source de magnésium et différents paramètres de formulation. Les matériaux obtenus seront caractérisés à l'aide de techniques complémentaires afin d'évaluer leur composition chimique, les phases formées lors de l'hydratation, leur microstructure, leur porosité et leurs propriétés mécaniques. Les principales étapes du stage seront les suivantes :

·        Étude bibliographique : synthèse des connaissances sur les liants magnésiens, leurs mécanismes d'hydratation et leurs applications potentielles.

·        Caractérisation des matières premières : étude de la composition chimique et minéralogique, de la distribution granulométrique (PSD) et de la réactivité des matières premières sélectionnées.

·        Formulation et préparation des liants : élaboration de pâtes de ciment de type MgO-SiO2 en utilisant différentes sources de magnésium et différents paramètres de préparation.

·        Caractérisation des matériaux : analyse des pâtes hydratées par diffraction des rayons X (DRX), analyse thermogravimétrique (ATG), microscopie électronique à balayage couplée à la spectroscopie à dispersion d'énergie (MEB/EDS), mesure de la porosité accessible à l'eau et essais mécaniques.

Analyse des résultats : comparaison des différentes formulations afin d'identifier les principaux paramètres influençant leur microstructure et leurs propriétés mécaniques.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs, spécialisé(e) en génie civil, science des matériaux ou domaine connexe.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

data.title: Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)
data.description:
Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI)

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

  • Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama

  • Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):

Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning

Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :

L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.

Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.

Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.

Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.

Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.

Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?

Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage

L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

  • Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

  • Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact).

Profil recherché

  • Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ;

  • Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API)

  • et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ;

  • Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier.

Références

Huguet M, Pehlivan C, Ballereau F, Dodane-Loyenet A, Fontanili F, Garaix T, Yordanov Y, Augusto V, Tazarourte K, Redjaline A. Indoor positioning systems provide insight into emergency department systems enabling proposal of designs to improve workflow. Commun Med (Lond). 2025 Mar 11;5(1):72.

Ayed SB, Layeb SB, Huguet M, Fontanili F, Samama N. Developing a Mobile Application and Dashboard for Proactive Management of Patient No- Shows via Geolocation and Dynamic Scheduling. In: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Healthcare Systems (ICAHS). IEEE; 2025 Dec. p. 1-5.

Trabelsi M, et al. TRACE4PM: Trace Related Analysis and Clustering for Process Modeling of Users Interactions in IS. In: RCIS 2025. Springer; 2025.

Rebmann A, et al. Evaluating the Ability of LLMs to Solve Semantics-Aware PM Tasks. In: ICPM 2024. IEEE; 2024.

Kourani H, Berti A, Schuster D, van der Aalst WMP. Process Modeling with Large Language Models. In: BPMDS/EMMSAD@CAiSE 2024. 2024. p. 229- 244.

data.title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein
data.description:
Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

 

Background and experience

  • Solid experience as a Compliance officer (2nd line of defense) in a regulated financial institution in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein, ideally with exposure to MLRO responsibilities or similar

  • Experience in engaging with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory authorities;

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

 

  • A competitive salary and benefits package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Opportunity to work remotely

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

 

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

data.title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
data.description:
Worum geht es?

Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Rund 400 Feuerwehren in 16 Kantonen arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen, von der Alarmierung über die Einsatzführung bis zur Einsatzplanung.

Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln.

Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team.

Über uns

Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend.

Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um.

  • Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren.

  • Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen.

  • Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle.

  • Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei.

  • Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb.

Perspektive

Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung.

  • Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git.

  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht.

  • Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt.

  • Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis.

  • Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

Unser Technologiestack

  • Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js

  • PostgreSQL und Redis

  • Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes

  • Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

  • REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen

  • KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Kurze Wege. Ein Standort, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung. Entscheide fallen am selben Tag, nicht im nächsten Gremium.

  • Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, ist innert Wochen bei Feuerwehren im Einsatz. Du bekommst Rückmeldungen von Menschen, die damit arbeiten.

  • Weiterbildung, die wir ernst meinen. Wir unterstützen berufsbegleitende Studiengänge.

  • 5 Wochen Ferien, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz.

  • Mitgestaltung. Technologieentscheide treffen wir gemeinsam, nicht von oben herab.

  • Thun. Arbeiten zwischen See und Bergen, 10 Minuten vom Bahnhof, 20 Minuten von Bern.

Ein Hinweis mit Ehrlichkeit

Wir arbeiten überwiegend vor Ort. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, reine Remote-Arbeit passt nicht zu uns. Die kurzen Abstimmungswege in der Entwicklung gehören zu unserer DNA.

Vergütung

Der Lohn für diese Stelle liegt bei CHF 68'000-80'000 pro Jahr bei einem Pensum von 100%.

So läuft die Bewerbung ab

  1. Bewerbung über die Plattform. Lebenslauf genügt, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Links zu Projekten oder Repositories schauen wir uns gerne an.

  2. Kurzes Kennenlernen, rund 30 Minuten per Video oder Telefon.

  3. Gespräch in Thun mit dem CTO und dem Entwicklungsteam, inkl. Blick in unsere Codebasis.

  4. Fachlicher Austausch anhand einer kleinen, realistischen Aufgabe. Kein Whiteboard-Rätsel, sondern etwas aus unserem Alltag.

  5. Entscheid spätestens 7 Tage nach dem letzten Gespräch.

Wir melden uns auf jede Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

data.title: Senior Solutions Architect
System Identification Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

 

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

data.description:
We are investigating real-time edge computing architectures to enhance visual feedback in next-generation medical robotics. Our systems combine high-bandwidth video streams with real-time robotic telemetry to support precision tasks.

• Telemetry & Visual Overlays: Ingest robotic telemetry alongside the video feed to render dynamic graphical annotations and spatial guidance cues directly onto the live stream.

Sie arbeiten gerne eigenständig, schätzen aber ebenso die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Know-how

data.title: Business Development Manager
data.description:
Do you want to contribute to Western resilience? Do you want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving lives?

Do you want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems?

Join us at CDDS to bring high-speed kinetic interceptor drones into the hands of armed forces, law enforcement agencies, and critical infrastructure operators.

CDDS specialises in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralise malicious drones (Mavic drones, FPV racing drones, and fast fixed-wing drones). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimising risk to the surrounding area while effectively countering unauthorised or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Your Mission

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to help grow CDDS's business from Switzerland across selected European and global markets. Your main focus will be identifying prospective customers and partners, opening new conversations, qualifying leads, and turning early interest into well-defined opportunities. Working closely with our engineering, product, operations, and leadership teams, you will connect customer needs with CDDS's capabilities and help build a strong, sustainable commercial pipeline.

What You'll Do

  • Help grow CDDS's business in selected European and global markets by building a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and partners.

  • Research and identify relevant organisations, programmes, decision-makers, and potential partners across defence, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and the wider security ecosystem.

  • Generate and qualify leads through targeted outreach, procurement monitoring, referrals, industry networks, events, and inbound enquiries.

  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand customer needs, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and next steps, and document clear qualification criteria.

  • Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and partners, maintain regular follow-up, and create momentum from first contact to active opportunity.

  • Keep CRM records, lead statuses, contact information, and follow-up actions accurate and current, providing clear visibility of the developing pipeline.

  • Coordinate customer meetings, demonstrations, and events with engineering, product, and operations teams, prepare relevant commercial materials, and manage follow-up actions.

  • Support responses to requests for information, proposals, and public tenders by coordinating inputs and ensuring opportunities continue to progress.

  • Work with leadership to prioritise qualified opportunities and support them through trials, proposals, contract discussions, and handover to delivery teams.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, market development, or a related customer-facing role, ideally in defence, security, public-sector technology, or another technical B2B environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify prospects, conduct outreach, build relationships, and convert early conversations into qualified opportunities.

  • Strong research and commercial curiosity, with the ability to understand an organisation, identify relevant stakeholders, and recognise where CDDS can create value.

  • Confident communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical capabilities in clear customer and operational terms.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

  • A structured approach to CRM, follow-up, prioritisation, and pipeline management, with attention to detail and reliable execution.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and operational colleagues in a fast-moving startup.

  • Based in Switzerland with eligibility to work in Switzerland and availability to travel regularly for customer meetings, demonstrations, and events.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience with UAS, counter-UAS, autonomous systems, air defence, or related defence and security technologies.

  • Experience working with armed forces, law enforcement agencies, critical infrastructure operators, government customers, or defence and security partners.

  • Familiarity with European defence and public-sector ecosystems, procurement processes, or industry networks.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or in bringing an emerging technical product to new customers and markets.

Benefits

Why CDDS

  • Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe's security landscape

  • Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership

  • Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team

  • Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations

  • Attractive compensation

Details

Location: Zurich, on site

Start date: ASAP

Environment: High‑impact deep‑tech startup working on real deployments

data.title: Product Marketing Manager
data.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.

 

What you'll do

  • Own positioning and messaging execution. Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

  • Build and maintain competitive intelligence. Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

  • Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

  • Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

  • Drive product launches and releases. Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

  • Fuel demand and thought leadership. Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

  • Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

 

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

  • Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

  • Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

  • A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

  • Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

  • Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

 

What you'll get

  • Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

  • Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.

  • Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives.

  • A company at an inflection point. It has a strong European base, fresh US market entry, and a proven platform to build the story on.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

  • Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

  • Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

  • Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

  • Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

  • Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

  • Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria.

  • Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering.


    • Requirements

  • You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units.

  • You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection.

  • You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

  • You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

  • You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers.

  • You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar.

  • You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.

    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd gerenommeerd architectuur- en stedenbouwkundig bureau met het hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en kantoren in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. MVRDV werd in 1993 opgericht door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries en zet zich in voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve, maatschappelijk verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft.

Als stagiair bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 200 professionals uit ruim 40 verschillende landen. Je doet praktijkervaring op in baanbrekende projecten, werkt samen met toonaangevende architecten en verlegt de grenzen van ontwerp en innovatie. Ben jij gepassioneerd over architectuur en wil je leren in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je.

Let op: We verzoeken recruitmentbureaus vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde kandidaten of profielen voor deze vacature aan te leveren. Wij verzorgen het wervingsproces intern en accepteren geen voorwaarden of vergoedingen met betrekking tot ongevraagde doorverwijzingen.

Sollicitatieprocedure

  1. Je kunt je sollicitatie indienen vanaf nu tot en met 16 november 2026.

  2. De gesprekken vinden plaats tussen 23 november en 11 december 2026.

  3. Succesvolle kandidaten starten op 1 maart 2027.

Belangrijk: Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze stage moet je gedurende de volledige stageperiode, van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027, ingeschreven blijven staan aan een daarvoor in aanmerking komende opleiding aan een universiteit of hogeschool.

Over het Design Collective

Het Design Collective van MVRDV is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve en duurzame gebouwen en constructies. We werken aan een breed scala aan projecten, van kleinschalige woningbouw tot grootschalige commerciële en culturele complexen. Bekijk enkele voorbeelden van onze projecten op: https://www.mvrdv.com/projects.

Het Design Collective richt zich op projecten in de volgende regio’s:

  • Nederland

  • Azië

  • DACH-regio

  • Franstalige landen

  • Noord-Amerika

  • Centraal- en Oost-Europa

  • Taiwan

Over de functie

Als Architectuurstagiair bij MVRDV kom je terecht in een dynamische omgeving waar gedurfde ideeën en snel schakelen dagelijks centraal staan. Je wordt begeleid door internationaal vooraanstaande ontwerpers bij projecten en prijsvragen en levert een bijdrage aan ambitieuze concepten, gedetailleerde tekeningen en indrukwekkende visualisaties.

Afhankelijk van jouw profiel en ervaring word je gekoppeld aan specifieke projecten, regio’s en/of projecttypen.

Dit is een uitstekende kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, je creativiteit uit te dagen en een realistisch beeld te krijgen van het werken aan de voorhoede van de architectuur.

Wat bieden wij?

For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

DevOps at SkinVision

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring.

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence.

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next.

What you will do

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting.

CI/CD & Deployment

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments.

  • Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes.

  • Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes.

  • Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

  • Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance.

data.title: Senior UX Designer
data.description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

data.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
data.description:
Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? Do you love diving into data, spotting opportunities, and turning ideas into measurable growth? Are you excited by opening new acquisition channels and finding smarter ways to grow in an AI-driven world?

AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue.

You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale.

A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue.

You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape.

Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results.


On a typical week

It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance.

After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch.

On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch.

Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps.

On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also start investigating new channels that could help expand the campaign's reach and attract new audiences.

Friday starts with reviewing the results of a recent landing page experiment. The changes have improved conversion, so you work with the CRO Specialist to roll them out more broadly. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. Before wrapping up the week, you review progress against our growth priorities, share your findings with the team, and identify the next opportunities worth pursuing.

After a productive week of analyzing, experimenting, and driving initiatives forward, you close your laptop and join your colleagues for Friday drinks.

We offer

  • A revenue-generating role in a fast-growing scale-up company; 

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a satellite office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work at AIHR

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 4 Trust days per year (ad-hoc recovery days to take whenever you're overwhelmed, exhausted, or need to deal with something personal);

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide!


Who you are

We're looking for an ambitious, data-driven, and commercially minded growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit. Someone who loves identifying opportunities, challenging existing approaches, and turning ideas into measurable results. You're not just a strategic thinker; you're equally excited about getting operational, executing ideas yourself, and making things happen.

You have:

  • 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling customer acquisition, ideally across both B2C and B2B businesses in SaaS, e-learning, or other high-growth industries;

  • Demonstrable experience scaling paid acquisition campaigns, including managing or scaling advertising budgets of €100,000+ per month;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dive into performance data, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable initiatives;

  • A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, including paid acquisition, CRO, landing page optimization, email marketing, and growth economics such as CAC and LTV;

  • Strong experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms, including segmentation, automation, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and reporting;

  • Experience identifying, testing, and scaling new acquisition channels and growth opportunities;

  • Strong AI proficiency, with experience using ChatGPT and Claude to analyze data, improve workflows, and accelerate execution;

  • An understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing customer acquisition, with a forward-thinking approach to emerging marketing channels;

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to independently lead and execute initiatives while collaborating effectively with the wider team;

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a hunger to grow;

  • Bonus: Experience in event marketing, community-led growth, or account-based marketing (ABM).

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our new Senior Growth Marketing Manager? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

data.title: Senior PHP Backend Developer
data.description:
About Shiftbase

At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe rely on our platform every day to plan work, track time, and manage leave, freeing them from unnecessary admin so they can focus on what matters and what sparked their business.

As we continue to grow in customers, usage and product ambition, the demands on our platform grow with us. Our backend needs to scale in quality, reliability and speed of change. That’s why we’re investing heavily in modernising our platform, building a foundation that allows us to move faster, deliver better experiences, and support the next phase of Shiftbase’s growth.

About the role:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you are a key driver of both product delivery and platform modernisation. You work on the core of our backend, improving reliability, performance and scalability, with the explicit goal of turning Shiftbase from a platform people enjoy into a platform they love.

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality.

What you'll do

Drive technical excellence

  • Design and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for complex features and system components

  • Make informed architectural decisions that balance pragmatism with long-term vision

  • Set the bar for technical craft through your contributions and code reviews

  • Own complex technical initiatives from design through production, breaking them into testable increments

Build for reliability and scale

  • Define comprehensive testing strategies for complex features, championing quality within the team

  • Debug and resolve complex issues across multiple components, improving system observability

  • Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle

  • Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health improvements

Enable team growth

  • Mentor engineers with targeted technical guidance and feedback

  • Support onboarding and enable a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment

  • Help shape delivery practices and improve team velocity through data-informed decisions


What we're looking for

Core technical expertise

You have deep backend engineering experience with complex, high-scale systems. We don't expect expertise in everything listed below. We value engineers who've built depth and breadth through genuine curiosity and a drive to solve real problems. These are examples of competencies that matter in this role:

  • Modern PHP & architectural patterns: Experience with hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, or similar patterns that emphasize domain modeling over framework magic. You can build maintainable systems without relying on framework shortcuts.

  • SQL & database design: Comfort writing raw SQL (not just ORM abstractions) and working with complex relational schemas particularly around time-sensitive data like scheduling, timesheets and payroll where integrity and performance are critical.

  • Legacy modernisation experience: You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers.

  • Monolith to services: Experience breaking down monoliths with good judgment about when distribution solves real problems (deployment bottlenecks, team autonomy) vs. when it adds unnecessary complexity.

  • Testing in legacy contexts: Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems.

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of

✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture

✅ You care about product quality, not just “shipping code”.

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features

✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions

This probably isn’t your dream job if…

⛔️ You only want to work on greenfield projects and avoid legacy systems altogether

⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements

⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them

⛔️ You’re looking for a role where architecture decisions are already “done”

⛔️ You’d rather optimise locally than care about the end-to-end product experience

Note: Candidates outside the Netherlands will not be considered

data.title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
data.description:
wo-afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten?
Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes.

Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig?

Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water.

Je gaat onder andere:

  • bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid;

  • onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten;

  • een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid;

  • de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête;

  • onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn;

  • je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS.

Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren.

In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS.

We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn:

  • Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS

  • Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS

  • Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten.

  • Je kunt goed programmeren in R.

  • Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen;

  • jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse;

  • jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt;

  • ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.
